title.narrative: Adaptive Safety Nets and Economic Inclusion Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to: (i) expand the coverage and shock-responsive capacity of the safety nets system for poor households, and (ii) increase access to income-generation and entrepreneurship support opportunities for youth in urban areas.

condition.narrative: ESCP: A Security Management Plan (SMP) if needed shall be completed, disclosed, consulted upon, approved, adopted prior to thecommencement of activities in the conflict areas.
ESCP: GBV/SEA/SH action plan shall be prepared, disclosed, consulted upon, and adopted not later than three months of the EffectiveDate.
ESCP: The final ESMF shall be prepared, redisclosed, consulted upon, and adopted not later than three months after the EffectiveDate.
ESCP: The final IPPF shall be updated as necessary and disclosed within three months after the Effective Date.
ESCP: The final LMP shall be updated, disclosed, consulted upon and adopted not later than three months after the Effective Date.

Financing Agreement: Schedule 2. Section I. A. 1 (a): The Recipient shall establish by no later than four (4) months after theEffective Date (or such later date as agreed with the Association), and thereafter maintain at all times during the implementationof the Project, the Project Steering Committee with a mandate, composition and resources satisfactory to the Association.

Financing Agreement: Schedule 2. Section I. A. 2 (c): Without limiting the foregoing, the PIU shall include, inter alia, (i) theProject Coordinator, (ii) a financial and administrative specialist, (iii) a field operations specialist, (iv) a communication andsocial marketing specialist, (v) an accompanying measures specialist (vi) a procurement specialist, (vii) an IT specialist, (viii)a cash for work specialist, (ix)a monitoring and evaluation specialist, (x) an environmental specialist, (xi) a social specialist,(xii) an accountant, (xiii) an internal auditor, (xiv) an economic inclusion specialist, (xv) a specialist to coordinate BusinessPlan Competition activities, (xvi) a gender-based violence specialist, and (xvii) a digital payments specialist; all such staff tobe appointed by no later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, and all with qualifications, experience, integrity and termsof reference acceptable to the Association.

Financing Agreement: Schedule 2. Section I. A. 2 (d): Without limiting the foregoing, not later than three (3) months after theEffective Date, the Recipient shall have recruited and appointed an external auditor, all with qualifications, experience,integrity and terms of reference acceptable to the Association.

Financing Agreement: Schedule 2. Section I. A. 6 (a): The Recipient shall not later than two (2) months after Effective Date,establish and operationalize a Special Procurement Commission for the Project in line with the Recipient's procurement regulations,to be responsible for overseeing the review of procurement documentation related to the Project.

Financing Agreement: Schedule 2. Section I. C (b): […] for the first year of Project implementation, the Recipient shall furnishthe draft annual work plan and budget by no later than one (1) month after the Effective Date.
